methodology.factor: Price vs 20-day EMA, previous close falling 8/9.5%, close near day low, prior 20d volume ratio, <=8 top-ranked symbols
methodology.eod_confirm: prior day drop, current green body>=5%, close high in candle, confirm after 13:30, buy next session open
methodology.survivor_pool_bias: 2026 stock futures research pool applied backward
methodology.corporate_actions: price jumps over 35pct excluded but full corporate actions not cleaned
methodology.money_model: Independent conditional paper sleeve, NO integration with original C26 cash/holdings; return not directly comparable with frozen C26.
methodology.drawdown_definition: Closed-event booking only; does not include intra-trade mark-to-market or overnight gap tail risk.

results.caveat: Closed-trade equity curve only (not intraday mark-to-market); NOT C26 full portfolio or guaranteed stop fills. Each missing exit stressed as -20% of that slot, no fictitious fill.
